CrawlEngine with defaults batch scrapes like the free function

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::{batch_scrape, shutdown_engine};
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let urls: Vec<String> = [r#"https://example.com/page1"#, r#"https://example.com/page2"#].into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let result = batch_scrape(&engine, urls).await.expect("call failed");
    shutdown_engine(engine).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.completed_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.total_count);
}
```
